location.name: The harbour office

view.text: The harbour office. A high desk, the tide book open, a telephone, a window over the berths.
The wall: the duty roster under a nail, the door to the pier.

location.asset: Tonight's page is in Thomas's hand. The turn of the tide, and beside it his own name and an hour, written twice: once in the column, once in the margin, small.
Night duty: T. Voss, tide clerk. Board-keeper: A. Penry, Bakery Row, who chalks the tide board and keeps the sluice chain.
It rings as you reach it. You lift it. Water on the line, and under the water a slow breath that is not a breath. You put it down.
Berth four below. Marsh stands on the Patience with his back to the shack, and the shack window burns for nobody.
location.ending: You read his hour into the receiver. The water on the line goes still to listen, and every telephone in Grayhaven begins to ring.
